text:
alina: Heads-up: automated alert from cert-guard for eu region — multiple proxy pods failing KMS decrypts around 02:14 UTC. stack trace says DecryptDenied for svc-proxy-watcher.
pete: did we push any IAM changes last night? i merged the keystore-role rename but thought we gated applies per-region.
natalie: i saw a partial terraform run for europe that errored on quota; logs: `ERROR: googleapi: Error 429: Quota exceeded: iam.requests per minute` — apply aborted before binding the new role.
zack: quick verification: `gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.serviceName="iam.googleapis.com" AND protoPayload.methodName:"SetIamPolicy" AND resource.labels.project_id="redwood-prod"' --freshness=1d` shows the set policy succeeded in global but not europe project.
alina: mitigation option A: rebind the old role (roles/keystoreViewer) to svc-proxy-watcher in eu project to restore decrypts; Option B: temporarily allow the service the new role by manual add-binding. thoughts?
pete: option A is fastest. we need to log the change and create a rollback plan. sec-bot: create incident INC-2026-047-eu-kms-iam.
sec-bot: INCIDENT_CREATED id=INC-2026-047-eu-kms-iam severity=high tags=[kms, iam, encryption-in-transit] owner=@alina
infra-bot: would you like me to run the quick bind? `run: gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding redwood-prod --member=serviceAccount:svc-proxy-watcher@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/keystoreViewer --condition=None`
natalie: please include a change note and ticket link. also add an audit log export for the failed apply events.
alina: go ahead infra-bot. run it in eu and then kick cert-guard resync.
infra-bot: CHANGELOG: quick_bind_eu_176789 — binding applied.
infra-bot: EXEC: `gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding redwood-prod --member=serviceAccount:svc-proxy-watcher@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/keystoreViewer --condition=None --project=redwood-prod` — OK
zack: after bind, cert-guard logs: `2026-03-21T02:17:05Z INFO cert-guard eu-west1 decrypt=OK certificates_synced=3` — services recovered.
pete: good. next steps: 1) re-run terraform in eu with exponential backoff + request quota bump to cloud support; 2) add CI lint to require PRs renaming IAM roles to include per-region apply checklist; 3) implement drift alert: compare desired IAM entries from terraform state vs actual via scheduled query and page us on mismatch.
natalie: for compliance, export the audit entries: `gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.methodName="google.iam.v1.IAM.SetIamPolicy" OR protoPayload.serviceName="cloudkms.googleapis.com"' --project=redwood-prod --limit=200` and attach to INC-2026-047.
alina: assign owners: pete -> infra changes + terraform retry, natalie -> audit export & compliance note, zack -> drift detector query + alert. ETA 36h.
sec-bot: ACTIONS_ASSIGNED [pete: infra+terraform, natalie: evidence+compliance, zack: drift-detector] ETA=36h
pete: small note: do NOT rotate keys during recovery window unless we have a tracked maintenance window; rebinding is safer.
alina: agree. we'll add a postmortem template to #postmortems once incident is closed.
zack: I'll also add a CI check that disallows role name-only renames without region mapping update.
aline (typo): thanks all — closing thread after we confirm terraform apply in eu succeeded and drift detector is green.
